details.name: Akekuri
details.quote: Captain Akekuri of Operation Team Z7 reporting in! The operations dossier, budget summary, and action plan are ready for review. Which would you like to read first?
details.infection: Oripathy negative, based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Team Management: Team Building She knows that patience and dedication are the secret ingredients needed to build and nurture a new team out of nothing.
details.exp2d: Cooking: Tea Breaks Hot drinks and desserts can quickly alleviate exhaustion, eliminate conflict, promote understanding, and expedite meetings.
details.hb1d: Charity: A Good Deed A Day Akekuri feels truly happy whenever she remembers that everything she does brings Endfield closer to its vision.
details.hb2d: Sports: Integrated Physical Training Akekuri has set aside fashion, fine arts, literature, and other things that once interested her. Instead, she now spends her time exercising.
details.matskill: Thermite Cutter, OBJ Edge of Lightness
